caseName: Greenway Apartment Co. v. Convention of Protestant Episcopal Church
caseNameFull: Greenway Apartment Co. v. The Convention of the Protestant Episcopal Church
attorneys: Mr. Isaac Lobe Strauss for appellant. Messrs. Charles F. Harley and Edward F. Bassett, with whom Messrs., Henry D. Harlan, Edw. Guest Gibson, and Burdette B. Webster were on the brief, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for the want of a-properly presented federal question, on the authority of Jett Bros. Distilling Company v. City of Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was allowed as a petition for certiorari, as required by § 237 (c) of the Judicial Code, as amended by the act of February 13, 1925 (c. 229, 43 Stat. 936, 938), the certiorari is denied.
